snippet.title: Stone Story Ascension Trailer - Back us on Kickstarter!
snippet.description:
BACK US ON KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rexgames/stone-story-ascension-a-deceptively-simple-idle-rpg?ref=project_build

Prepare to Ascend in this standalone sequel to Stone Story RPG!

Stone Story Ascension is an idle RPG where you guide your Stonehead avatar up into a perilous realm above the clouds. Lead them through Acropolis, the ruined city in the sky, now overrun with wild monsters, weird magicks, and even weirder people.

Stone Story Ascension is a standalone sequel to the 2023 game, Stone Story RPG. Journey with your Stonehead through the winding city streets of Acropolis, encountering the beings who still call this place "home". Experience a Dark World of living text, where doom and whimsy are found in equal measure.

[Kickstarter Trailer Music by Moonsailor: https://moonsailor.com]

===

Stone Story is an auto-RPG with strategic combat, deep crafting and programming elements, animated entirely in ASCII-art, out now on PC and mobile.

Play Now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/603390/Stone_Story_RPG/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MartianRexInc.StoneStory
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stone-story-rpg/id1076120218

Learn more:
Web: http://stonestoryrpg.com/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/stonestoryrpg
